items.title: Nginx UI 节点密钥认证绕过
items.title_zh: Nginx UI 节点密钥认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 持有有效令牌者可将其作为 X-Node-Secret，冒充可信节点访问集群管理接口，读取配置并重启服务。
items.affected: nginxui nginx_ui >=2.0.0 <2.5.0
items.action_zh: 升级到 2.5.0，轮换节点密钥并限制集群端口访问
items.repro_note: 需有效令牌，将其作为 X-Node-Secret 冒充可信节点
items.impact_scope: Nginx 管理面，可横向至集群节点
items.description: The same token is accepted as X-Node-Secret by AuthRequired and maps the request to initUser, allowing the user to impersonate a trusted node against a reachable cluster member. This cross-node authentication bypass can expose sensitive management operations, including configuration synchronization and service restart.

items.title: Nginx UI 密钥泄露认证绕过
items.title_zh: Nginx UI 密钥泄露认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 获取泄露密钥者可绕过密码、JWT、会话及二次验证，持续访问管理 API 并读取敏感配置。
items.affected: nginxui nginx_ui >=2.0.0 <2.5.0

items.impact_scope: Nginx 管理面，配置与密钥泄露
items.description: Nginx UI is a web user interface for the Nginx web server. A party that obtains the secret can bypass normal password, JWT, session, and second-factor checks and obtain persistent administrative API access, including access to configuration and secret material.

items.title: Nginx UI 管理接口 CSRF
items.title_zh: Nginx UI 管理接口 CSRF
items.summary_zh: 攻击者诱导已登录管理员访问恶意页面，跨站提交 POST /api/configs 修改配置，可能导致配置被篡改。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.affected: nginxui nginx_ui >=2.0.0 <2.5.0
items.action_zh: 升级到 2.5.0，限制管理面来源并启用 CSRF/Origin 校验
items.repro_note: 管理员登录后访问恶意页面，跨站 POST /api/configs
items.impact_scope: Nginx 管理面，管理员浏览器为跳板
items.description: Because management endpoints do not universally require a CSRF token or perform Origin or Referer validation, a remote attacker can induce a logged-in administrator's browser to submit authenticated cross-site state-changing requests, including POST /api/configs. The attacker cannot read the cross-origin response but can modify Nginx configuration, trigger reloads, or invoke other management operations reachable with the victim's session.

items.title: Nginx UI 绕过 Passkey 认证
items.title_zh: Nginx UI 绕过 Passkey 认证

items.affected: nginxui nginx_ui >=2.0.0 <2.5.0

items.repro_note: 需已知账户密码，登录时绕过 Passkey 校验接管账户
items.impact_scope: Nginx 管理面，账户接管风险
items.description: Nginx UI is a web user interface for the Nginx web server. An attacker who obtains the password can take over the account and reach administrative functionality without the registered passkey.

items.title: Nginx UI 文件链接绕过注入
items.title_zh: Nginx UI 文件链接绕过注入

items.affected: nginxui nginx_ui >=2.0.0 <2.5.0
items.action_zh: 升级到 2.5.0，校验配置目录符号链接并限制文件写入权限
items.repro_note: 需可写配置路径，利用符号链接绕过文件校验后注入配置
items.impact_scope: Nginx 配置面，配置持久化污染
items.description: Nginx UI is a web user interface for the Nginx web server. This can persistently inject configuration or cause denial of service when the modified files are later consumed.

items.title: Nginx UI 升级校验供应链风险
items.title_zh: Nginx UI 升级校验供应链风险
items.summary_zh: 能篡改镜像响应的网络攻击者可提供恶意升级包及匹配摘要，待管理员触发升级后在进程内执行代码。
items.difficulty: 中(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证·需用户交互)
items.affected: nginxui nginx_ui >=2.0.0 <2.5.0
items.action_zh: 升级到 2.5.0，启用签名校验并仅从可信镜像升级
items.repro_note: 需中间人篡改升级响应并诱导管理员执行升级
items.impact_scope: Nginx UI 主机，升级链路供应链
items.description: A compromised mirror or network attacker able to alter both responses can supply a malicious executable and matching digest. An operator-triggered upgrade is required, and the application installs and runs the attacker-controlled code in the Nginx UI process context on the next upgrade.

items.title: Nginx UI 备份恢复代码注入
items.title_zh: Nginx UI 备份恢复代码注入
items.summary_zh: 已登录管理员可向 /api/restore 提交恶意备份密钥与清单，恢复流程替换 app.ini 并注入命令执行。
items.affected: nginxui nginx_ui >=2.3.8 <2.5.0
items.action_zh: 升级到 2.5.0，限制管理员权限并审计恢复操作
items.repro_note: 需管理员会话，向 POST /api/restore 提交恶意密钥与清单
items.impact_scope: Nginx UI 主机，认证后代码执行
items.description: From 2.3.8 until 2.5.0, an authenticated administrator with an active secure session can submit attacker-controlled portable backup key material and a matching manifest to POST /api/restore. The restore flow trusts the supplied key, decrypts attacker-controlled contents, and replaces the live app.ini, including protected nginx command settings such as TestConfigCmd.

items.title: Tomcat JNDI Realm 认证绕过
items.title_zh: Tomcat JNDI Realm 认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 使用非 GSSAPI SASL 的 JNDI Realm 配置下，未认证攻击者可绕过密码校验完成认证。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)

items.impact_scope: Tomcat Web 中间件，认证绕过
items.description: A missing critical step in authentication vulnerability in Apache Tomcat when the JNDI realm was configured with with a non GSSAPI SASL authentication mechanism allowed attackers to authenticate without providing the correct password. This issue affects Apache Tomcat: from 11.0.0-M1 through 11.0.26, from 10.1.0-M1 through 10.1.60, from 9.0.0.M1 through 9.0.122.

items.title: Tomcat HTTP/2 异步请求混淆
items.title_zh: Tomcat HTTP/2 异步请求混淆
items.summary_zh: 在 HTTP/2 异步 Servlet 场景，攻击者可触发请求/响应对象复用错乱，造成跨用户数据混淆或泄露。
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.repro_note: 需 HTTP/2 与异步 Servlet，构造并发请求触发对象复用错乱
items.impact_scope: Tomcat Web 中间件，跨用户数据风险
items.description: Incorrect object recycling and re-use vulnerability in Apache Tomcat affecting HTTP/2 processing of asynchronous servlets can trigger request and/or response mix-up between users. This issue affects Apache Tomcat: from 11.0.22 through 11.0.26, from 10.1.55 through 10.1.60, from 9.0.118 through 9.0.122. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 11.0.27, 10.1.61 or 9.0.123, which fixes the issue.

items.title: Tomcat 非阻塞写响应越界读
items.title_zh: Tomcat 非阻塞写响应越界读
items.summary_zh: 攻击者触发大块非阻塞写时，响应体可能串到下一请求，导致第二请求失败并泄露首个响应数据。
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至厂商修复版本，避免非阻塞大响应并审计连接
items.repro_note: 需大块非阻塞写场景，构造连续请求触发响应体串包
items.impact_scope: Tomcat Web 中间件，响应数据泄露
items.description: Buffer under-read vulnerability in Apache Tomcat meant that a large non-blocking write could result in the response body being split between the current request and the next request received on that connection leading most likely to failure of the second request and possibly leakage of data from the first response to the second. This issue affects Apache Tomcat: from 11.0.0-M25 through 11.0.26. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 11.0.27, which fixes the issue.

items.description: Prior to 1.9.2, the unauthenticated POST /api/fetch-ical endpoint validates a caller-supplied hostname with one DNS lookup and then passes the URL to fetch, which performs a separate lookup for the socket connection. An attacker controlling authoritative DNS can return a public address during validation and then rebind the hostname to a loopback, private, link-local, or cloud metadata address for the connection, causing the server to return up to 10 MB of an internal HTTP or HTTPS response.

items.title: Helm CWE-829
items.description: Helm automatically loads a downloader plugin from `<configHome>/.data/plugins` without a separate plugin-install step and executes its program inside argocd-repo-server when a helmCharts repository URL uses the plugin's protocol. An attacker can commit the Kustomization and plugin to a Git repository that an Application builds or upload the files through POST /api/v1/applications/manifestsWithFiles, also exposed by argocd app diff --local --server-side-generate.
